purpose: Fit the repeat-case smooth continuum after replacing only data-defined narrow high-frequency lines with a local robust floor, while profiling the post-filter white floor and retaining stability/boundary diagnostics.
guardrail: The repaired target is diagnostic-only and changes only data-defined narrow-line intervals above 40 kHz. The optimizer never chooses the mask. Broad shoulders/humps remain in the target. White-floor and readout parameters remain effective nuisance/measurement-shape coordinates, not identified hardware components.
